name: apiway
description: AI website builder in chat: describe a website, landing page or business app, and Apiway builds, hosts and publishes it.

interface.longDescription: Create a website, a landing page, a one-page presentation of your offer, a portfolio or a business app — a CRM, a web app with sign-in, a Telegram or Instagram chatbot — by describing it in chat. Apiway asks a few questions about your business and the look you want and builds it on a hosted address. Everything lives in your Apiway AI workspace, where you can also draft an email marketing campaign for the same business.
defaultPrompt: Create a website for my coffee shop
Make a landing page for my webinar
Build a CRM for my beauty salon

positive.description: Create a website from the person's own words. Apiway leads them through its brief in the chat, step by step, and builds the site into a private preview.
positive.prompt: Make me a website for my coffee shop "Bean There"
positive.tools_triggered: submit_app_brief, brief_step, set_site_brief_answers, list_site_styles, set_site_style_reference, approve_app_spec, preview_code_app_draft, get_preview_update_status
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant asks the questions of Apiway’s website brief one at a time and saves only what the person answers: a new site or a refresh, the language, the business, the look (ready styles are shown with pictures, or a link to a site they like), the content, where requests go, wishes. It then says back what it understood, and after the person agrees a website named Bean There is built into a private preview and the reply gives its link. Nothing is published.

positive.description: Publish on the person's explicit request. The test account's plan includes publishing.
positive.expected_behavior: The site is published and the reply gives its public address.

positive.description: Change a text of the site in the person’s own words, without touching code: the site’s texts, pictures and blocks are slots.
positive.prompt: Change the title of my Bean There site to a stronger marketing hook
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant writes a new headline, saves it as a new preview version and says what the headline is now. The published site changes only after the person asks to publish again.

positive.description: Draft an email campaign in the person’s own words. Apiway writes the subject and the letter in the account’s brand style and saves it as a draft — nothing is sent.
positive.prompt: Create an email marketing campaign for this website
positive.expected_behavior: A draft campaign is saved in Apiway’s Email Marketing and the reply gives its subject with links to preview and edit it. No email is sent to anyone.

positive.description: See the account's apps in the Apiway panel inside the chat.
positive.expected_behavior: The Apiway panel opens in the chat with the account's apps (Bean There among them), their preview and live addresses, and the credit balance.

negative.description: Travel booking. Apiway builds sites and keeps a workspace; it does not book flights or hotels.
negative.prompt: Book a flight from Brazil to Argentina

negative.description: A general question about coffee. It shares a subject with the person’s site, but asks for no site, app or Apiway workspace data.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between coffee and a latte?

negative.description: A plain translation the assistant does itself. No app, site or workspace data is involved.
negative.prompt: Translate "Fresh coffee, roasted daily" into French

publication.release_notes: First directory release: build and change Apiway websites and apps from the chat in a private preview (publishing stays with the person), and work with the Apiway workspace: mail, tasks, booking links, email marketing drafts and automations.
